response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web software developer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and D-language backend skills, but the resume shows no evidence of SoC/IP modeling, hardware architecture, GPU/accelerator work, or deep-learning performance optimization — the core requirements of this Principal Performance Architect role. While he has 15+ years of experience and some low-latency systems work, the domain mismatch is fundamental rather than a gap that could be bridged quickly at a principal level.
strengths: Extensive (15+ years) software engineering experience meeting the BS + 8 years bar
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience (DLang, async I/O, caching, fibers)
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, open-source contributions and community teaching
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, hardware design, or hardware-software co-design experience
No GPU architecture, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator performance analysis background
No deep-learning training/inference optimization work; AI exposure limited to agent tooling (MCP)

key_factors.factor: No AI accelerator / DL workload optimization background
Solid general engineering seniority and performance-oriented systems work
